title: Meal planning app
summary: Plan your weekly meals and generate a shopping list automatically.
whyTempting: Deciding what to cook is a daily pain and tied to health goals.
whyItFails: Plans don't survive real life. Users abandon plans by midweek. Free recipe content. Recipes are free everywhere. Low willingness to pay. Hard to charge more than a few dollars.
whatWouldChange: AI that adapts plans to what's actually in the fridge and integrates grocery checkout.

attempts.outcome: Acquired by Samsung, rebranded Samsung Food
attempts.notes: Recipe saving and meal planning app; acquired quietly in 2019.

reasons.detail: Plans don't survive real life: Users abandon plans by midweek.
Free recipe content: Recipes are free everywhere.
Low willingness to pay: Hard to charge more than a few dollars.
